# DORIS — DORset Integrated Seabed survey (Channel Coastal Observatory), Crown Copyright.
# Its FGDC records state no licence and grant reuse in the body of <metcom> instead, so it
# mirrors as its own source rather than under uk_cco's OGL. NOT for navigation.
# Regenerated by `sources/uk_cco/harvest.py <work_dir> --doris` — one harvest, two sources.
# 48 zips, one per OS 5 km square per resolution (`<square>_<cellsize>m.zip`),
# each holding the newest surveyed ESRI ASCII grid of every OS 1 km square it covers.
# These are our R2 MIRROR: CCO ships data only through a session-cookied basket and a
# tokenised, server-compiled download, so sources/uk_cco/harvest.py harvests and repacks
# once and this file_list then fetches the mirror over public HTTPS, no session, fully
# CI-reproducible. Refresh = re-harvest + re-sync when CCO publishes new surveys.
